image_location_description: Lower left of the figure (viewer’s left leg)

steps.title: Foot sole
steps.description: Place 1 white 2x4 plate as the foot bottom (studs up).

steps.title: Foot thickness
steps.description: Stack 1 white 2x4 plate on top to thicken the foot.

steps.title: Foot top shape
steps.description: Add 1 white 2x3 plate at heel + 1 white 1x4 plate at toe.

steps.title: Ankle pad
steps.description: Center 1 white 2x2 plate on top, toward the heel.

steps.title: Leg base layer
steps.description: On ankle pad, place 2 white 1x2 bricks to form a 2x2 layer.

steps.title: Shin w/ side stud
steps.description: Next layer: 1 white 1x2 brick + 1 white headlight (stud outward) + 1 white 1x1 brick.

steps.title: Mid leg layer
steps.description: Stack 2 white 1x2 bricks to keep a 2x2 leg.

steps.title: Upper shin side stud
steps.description: Repeat: 1 white 1x2 brick + 1 white headlight outward + 1 white 1x1 brick.

steps.title: Thigh layer
steps.description: Stack 2 white 1x2 bricks to finish the blocky leg.

steps.title: Top cap
steps.description: Cap with 2 white 1x2 plates; add 1 white 1x1 plate at front.

steps.title: Tan stripe accents
steps.description: Attach 2 tan 1x2 plates onto the 2 outward headlight studs.
